title: Legacy Console Edition Swing Animation
description: This mod brings the TU13 swing animation to Java Edition.
body:
**Legacy Swing Animation brings back the iconic, glitched TU13-style hand swing motion to modern Minecraft versions.**

# Video Preview
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/kTVpIkeOod4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# ✨ Features ✨
## **Authentic TU13 Swing** 
Replicates the classic glitched swing animation as closely as possible.

## **Cooldown Disabler** 
You can disable the modern raise/lower animation for tools completely for an even more classic experience.

## Fully Configurable
Easily tweak your settings in-game via the **Mod Menu configuration screen**, or by **hitting the default keybind of 'P'** (custom hotkeys are available).
